name: Waste, next collection
description: The next waste collection from Mijn Afvalwijzer: which bin goes out and on what day, with an icon. As a round tile in the style of the home battery rings (the next collection, with a ring that fills as the day comes closer), or as a short list of the next collections. Needs your postcode and house number under Settings › Widgets › Mijn Afvalwijzer. The same dates can also show in Agenda, with travel time.

cell_options.help: The tile suits a small cell next to the battery rings; the list a taller one.
